pr_title: Fix osu!catch playfield bounds not matching expectations
pr_body:
- Playfield was scaled using 0.86f, not 0.8f (cross-check with `OsuPlayfieldAdjustmentContainer`). Changing this fixes horizontal sizing.
- After changing to 0.8f, the vertical alignment did not match correctly. I ported over stable's method, which is using a playfield range of -100..340 instead of the standard 0..384 (see the `FruitCircle` transform for reference, in osu-stable codebase)
- Closes #8221

Note: below visual is not what I used to make these changes, and only provided as a rough reference. I was going by actual size data so it should be 1:1 now.

![2020-08-20 19 14 37](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/191335/90758160-8ac3d980-e319-11ea-9ee7-b77bc05af3a6.gif)

A few things I'm not 100% on, but can be fixed as follow-up if/when necessary:
- The catcher looks visually smaller on lazer, but the difference is <2% and that can be fixed separately (is not affected by this PR). It may just be sprite resizing differences.
- In stable, the playfield is offset more from the top than the bottom of the screen (this goes for osu! mode too). It's doing a vertical offset from screen-top of `(parentHeight - playfieldHeight) * 4 / 3`, so 3/4 of the spacing is at that top while 1/4 is at the bottom. I don't believe we're doing that anywhere in lazer (correct me if i've missed it), so I'm not sure why vertical alignment is correct without making this change.
pr_comments: As an "empirical review" I made [this video](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mVgvSiRjave87QAky_B3g_ybrihv_mVg/view) - I overlaid lazer gameplay over stable's. It's not perfect (because of frame offset, droplet rotation, etc) but the horizontal range seems spot on. Vertical might be slightly off but that's way more difficult to accurately line up, and looks close enough to me anyway.

issue_context.title: osu!catch playfield is wider than in stable
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** osu!catch playfield is widher than in stable
I don't know if it's intended.

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 
![comp](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11272924/76415412-727a8680-6399-11ea-926f-826055959377.png)

bottom is osu!lazer

**osu!lazer version:** 
2020.311.0
comments: I believe this is intentional to make better use of the screen (see catcher sprite in top image isn't extending to the bottom of the screen), but should be checked at some point in more detail.

Putting this in the milestone since I have multiple people explaining that catch feels wrong to play with the current aspect ratio. Similar to moving between osu!stable and osu!lazer in osu!, I think this is probably something we should look into/adjust if it's hold players off from giving lazer a decent shot.

review_comments: I'm a bit lost with this comment (probably because I've barely read catch code) - why does anchor impact readability?

The difference is if you make the window very tall. You will be able to see fruit earlier than intended. If you compare a release build or master to this PR, you should notice the difference (this PR will show more view range, compared to master).
Oh, tall windows as in literal game windows, gotcha. Not sure why I interpreted it the way I did at first as it makes no sense in retrospect...
If we're now sharing this constant with `OsuPlayfieldAdjustmentContainer`, maybe it should be somewhere common?
Yeah, not sure about this just yet. I think keeping it local is fine for now since it's only two rulesets which use this.
